stories.title: OpenAI 对话 Gilbert + Tobin CEO：律所如何用 AI 重构法律业务
stories.sourceTitle: Gilbert + Tobin rethinks the business of law with AI
stories.summary: OpenAI News 发布与 Gilbert + Tobin 合伙人兼 CEO Sam Nickless 的对话，讨论律所如何借助 AI 重新思考法律业务。值得关注传统专业服务如何落地生成式 AI。
stories.analysis: 法律行业是高价值知识工作，若头部律所公开实践，可能加速 AI 在合规审查和知识管理中的采用。
stories.sourceExcerpt: A conversation with Sam Nickless, Partner and Chief Executive Officer at Gilbert + Tobin.

stories.title: NVIDIA 董事会据报准备解雇 CEO 黄仁勋
stories.sourceTitle: Nvidia is reportedly preparing to fire Jensen Huang
stories.summary: The Verge 援引《华尔街日报》称，NVIDIA 董事会在《纽约时报》曝出黄仁勋第二段婚外情指控后，正准备罢免这位 CEO；此前他已承认另一段与据称中国间谍有关的女性的婚外情。
stories.analysis: 若消息属实，这将是 AI 芯片龙头最剧烈的治理震荡，市场会立即重估 NVIDIA 战略连续性和供应链信心。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Nvidia's board is preparing to dismiss CEO Jensen Huang following a report from the New York Times about a second alleged extramarital affair, just days after he admitted to a separate affair with a woman alleged to be a Chinese spy, The Wall Street Journal re

stories.title: TechCrunch 盘点黄仁勋潜在继任者：NVIDIA 没有公开接班计划
stories.sourceTitle: Who could replace Jensen Huang? A highly unscientific list of possible successors
stories.summary: TechCrunch 称 NVIDIA 没有公开的继任计划，而 CEO 黄仁勋正陷舆论风波，于是列出可能的接班人短名单，并自称方法“非常不科学”。
stories.analysis: 继任者讨论反映投资者开始把个人风险纳入 NVIDIA 治理评估，但名单本身更像媒体推演。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Nvidia has no succession plan and a CEO in hot water, so we’ve drafted a shortlist.

stories.title: TechCrunch：你担心的数据中心，可能根本建不起来
stories.sourceTitle: Why the data center you dread might never even be built
stories.summary: TechCrunch 指出数据中心热潮遇到地方反对、审批延迟和电力争夺等现实障碍，而且很多项目在动工前就因更基础的问题停滞。
stories.analysis: AI 算力扩张不再只是芯片问题，选址、许可和供电正成为决定数据中心能否落地的瓶颈。
stories.sourceExcerpt: The data center boom is running into serious real-world obstacles, from widespread local opposition and permitting delays to a scramble for electricity. Before those challenges even come into play, though, there’s a more basic problem: A lot of the projects be

stories.title: TechCrunch：地方反对与审批繁文缛节仍在拖慢数据中心建设
stories.sourceTitle: How backlash and red tape continue to slow data centers post-Blue Wave
stories.summary: TechCrunch 称数据中心热潮面临广泛地方反对、许可延迟和电力紧张，这些阻力在“Blue Wave”之后仍持续拖慢项目推进。
stories.analysis: 数据中心建设的社会许可正在收紧，AI 公司需要更早处理社区关系和能源配套。
stories.sourceExcerpt: The data center boom is running into serious real-world obstacles, from widespread local opposition and permitting delays to a scramble for electricity. Before those challenges even come into play, though, there’s a more basic problem: A lot of the projects be

stories.title: 美联航拒绝让个人 AI 助手代订机票
stories.sourceTitle: United won’t let your AI agent book your flight
stories.summary: The Verge 援引《华尔街日报》称，美联航以隐私和监管顾虑为由，不允许个人 AI 助手在该航司订票；公司表示目前尝试用 AI agent 订票的人还不多。
stories.analysis: 航司对 AI agent 的抵制显示，代理式 AI 进入交易环节时，身份验证、责任归属和反欺诈规则仍是门槛。
stories.sourceExcerpt: United says it won't let personal AI assistants book tickets on the airline, citing both privacy and regulatory concerns. The company says it hasn't yet seen many people try to use AI agents to book their flights, The Wall Street Journal reports, in line with

stories.title: TechCrunch 梳理黄仁勋风波时间线：婚外情指控如何牵动国家安全
stories.sourceTitle: The unfolding Jensen Huang scandal: a timeline
stories.summary: TechCrunch 按时间线整理黄仁勋婚外情指控的发酵过程，并指出事件可能在中美竞逐先进 AI 基础设施之际带来国家安全影响。
stories.analysis: 当芯片龙头 CEO 的私人丑闻与地缘政治交织，企业治理问题会迅速升级为政策和供应链风险。
stories.sourceExcerpt: The affair could have ramifications for national security as the U.S. and China race to develop the most advanced AI infrastructure.

stories.title: 英国 Fractile 融资 7.2 亿美元，加码专用 AI 芯片竞赛
stories.sourceTitle: With $720M round, Britain’s Fractile gets a leg up in the race for AI chips
stories.summary: TechCrunch 报道，英国 AI 芯片公司 Fractile 完成 7.2 亿美元融资，成为专用 AI 芯片赛道中融资额最高的玩家之一。
stories.analysis: 大额融资说明资本仍在寻找 NVIDIA 之外的专用芯片机会，但商业化仍要看软件生态和量产能力。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Fractile has now become one of the top-funded players in the race for purpose-built AI chips.

stories.title: NVIDIA 股价下跌：董事会据报准备罢免黄仁勋
stories.sourceTitle: Nvidia’s stock drops as board reportedly preps to oust CEO Jensen Huang
stories.summary: TechCrunch 称，NVIDIA 董事会最早可能在周三晚间决定是否罢免创立并执掌公司 33 年的 CEO 黄仁勋，股价已因此下跌。
stories.analysis: 董事会若真的行动，短期市场冲击会很大，关键看是否有明确过渡方案和客户信心维护。
stories.sourceExcerpt: As soon as Wednesday evening, Nvidia's board could decide to remove its founder and CEO of 33 years.

stories.title: 黄仁勋被指与 NVIDIA 高管发生另一段婚外情
stories.sourceTitle: Jensen Huang accused of having another affair — with an Nvidia exec
stories.summary: TechCrunch 报道，黄仁勋在承认与一名被指为中国情报人员的女性有婚外情后，又被指与一名 NVIDIA 下属存在另一段婚外情。
stories.analysis: 连续指控把焦点从个人道德扩展到公司内控和国家安全审查，NVIDIA 的治理透明度将受考验。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Jensen Huang, who has come under fire for admitting to an affair with a woman accused of being a Chinese intelligence agent, has been accused of having a separate affair with an Nvidia subordinate.

stories.title: Google DeepMind 发布 AlphaGenome 2，追踪 DNA 变化如何影响不同细胞
stories.sourceTitle: Google’s AlphaGenome 2 zooms in on the cellular roots of disease
stories.summary: Google DeepMind 研究人员推出 AlphaGenome 2，旨在解析 DNA 变化如何影响不同细胞，为理解疾病成因提供更细致的视角。
stories.analysis: 这类模型把 AI 从文本生成推向基础生物学发现，长期价值在于缩短疾病机制研究和药物靶点发现周期。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Researchers at Google DeepMind have unveiled a new AI model designed to unravel how changes in our DNA affect different cells, giving scientists a more detailed view of a notoriously difficult problem that could hold important clues to the causes of disease -

stories.title: Google Labs 推出 Tabletop：可定制的群组协作空间
stories.sourceTitle: Try Tabletop: Customizable, collaborative spaces for groups to plan, play and do more together.
stories.summary: Google Labs 发布新实验 Tabletop，让团队创建互动行程、投票和对阵表等协作空间，目前开放等候名单。
stories.analysis: Tabletop 把生成式 AI 嵌入群体规划场景，测试 AI 能否从个人助手变成多人协作的组织层。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Tabletop is a new Google Labs experiment for group collaboration. Build interactive itineraries, polls, and brackets with your team. Join the waitlist.

stories.title: Adobe 展示 AI 实验：走进照片、采访角色
stories.sourceTitle: Adobe’s AI experiments let you walk around in photos and interview your characters
stories.summary: Adobe 在 Max 大会上公布实验性 AI 工具，可把图片转成可探索的 3D 场景，并支持设计 AI 角色、与角色互动采访。
stories.analysis: Adobe 把实验功能放在创作工具前沿，若产品化将改变影像、游戏和叙事内容的制作流程。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Some of the most impressive tech that Adobe showcases at its annual Max conference each year is the experimental features it's developing, and the latest of those tools are being announced today: they can transform images into explorable 3D scenes, design AI c

stories.title: 美国国会传唤黄仁勋，就涉中国间谍婚外情指控闭门说明
stories.sourceTitle: Congress to call Jensen Huang in to answer for alleged Chinese spy affair
stories.summary: TechCrunch 称，美国众议院共和党人要求 NVIDIA CEO 黄仁勋在周三结束前回应闭门简报要求，就他与被指中国间谍的女性婚外情作出说明。
stories.analysis: 国会介入意味着事件已从公司治理上升到国家安全审查，NVIDIA 与政策制定者的关系将更紧张。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has until the end of the day Wednesday to answer a call from House Republicans for a closed-door briefing on his affair with alleged Chinese spy.

stories.title: Meta 基础设施长期负责人 Santosh Janardhan 将离职
stories.sourceTitle: Meta is losing its longtime head of infrastructure
stories.summary: TechCrunch 报道，2009 年加入 Meta 的基础设施负责人 Santosh Janardhan 将卸任。
stories.analysis: 在 AI 数据中心和算力军备竞赛关键期，基础设施负责人离职可能影响 Meta 的扩张节奏与执行稳定性。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Santosh Janardhan, who originally joined the company in 2009, will be stepping down from his role.

stories.title: CoreWeave 转向客户预付款和短约，为 AI 扩张融资
stories.sourceTitle: CoreWeave turns to customer prepayments, shorter contracts to fund AI growth
stories.summary: TechCrunch 根据 CoreWeave 三季度财报称，该公司越来越多要求客户预付、以特定合同借款，并考虑短期交易，可能带来更高价格。
stories.analysis: 这显示 AI 云厂商在高速扩张中面临资本压力，融资结构变化会影响其定价和客户黏性。
stories.sourceExcerpt: CoreWeave is increasingly asking customers to pay up front, borrowing against specific contracts, and even looking to short-term deals that could lead to higher prices, according to the company’s third-quarter earnings.

stories.title: Google 发布 Gemini Decisions API：面向快速、校准的多模态决策
stories.sourceTitle: Gemini Decisions API: Fast, calibrated multimodal decisions
stories.summary: Google 推出由 Gemini Decision 模型驱动的 Decisions API，主打快速且经过校准的多模态决策能力。
stories.analysis: 决策型 API 把模型能力包装成可嵌入业务流程的接口，重点在可靠性和校准，而不只是生成质量。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Meet the Gemini Decisions API, powered by our state-of-the-art model Gemini Decision for fast, calibrated multimodal decisions.

stories.title: Google Tabletop 实验：用 AI 生成定制化协作应用
stories.sourceTitle: Google’s Tabletop AI experiment lets you build custom collaboration apps
stories.summary: The Verge 报道，Google 推出实验性 AI 工具 Tabletop，可生成定制协作中心，帮助用户与家人朋友协调事务，界面类似 Asana 等工作管理应用。
stories.analysis: 这是 Google 在 AI 协作层的新试探，能否成功取决于生成结果是否真的比现成模板更实用。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Google has cooked up a new experimental AI tool called Tabletop that generates customized collaborative hubs to help you coordinate with family, and friends. The Tabletop platform shares some visual similarities with workplace management apps like Asana and Mo

stories.title: TechCrunch 追问：黄仁勋的不当行为是否比想象中更普遍？
stories.sourceTitle: Is Jensen Huang’s bad behavior more commonplace than it seems?
stories.summary: TechCrunch 采访投资情报顾问称，业内很多资深人士知道类似行为并在事实上纵容，文章由此讨论黄仁勋风波是否只是冰山一角。
stories.analysis: 报道把个案转向行业文化问题，但相关说法依赖匿名或单方信源，需谨慎看待。
stories.sourceExcerpt: “There are a lot of senior people in the industry that know this is happening, and are effectively condoning it,” an investment intel consultant said.

stories.title: OpenAI 季度营收据报首次突破 100 亿美元
stories.sourceTitle: OpenAI’s quarterly revenue reportedly crosses $10B for the first time
stories.summary: TechCrunch 称，OpenAI 季度销售额首次达到 100 亿美元，较第二季度的 67 亿美元增长近 50%。
stories.analysis: 若数据准确，OpenAI 的商业化速度仍处高位，但高营收能否覆盖巨额算力和研发支出仍是核心问题。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Sales of $10 billion represents an almost 50% jump from revenue of $6.7 billion the company recorded in the second quarter.

stories.title: Databricks 新 AI agent 向 CEO Ali Ghodsi 汇报“不加修饰的真相”
stories.sourceTitle: Databricks’ new AI agent tells CEO Ali Ghodsi the unvarnished truth
stories.summary: TechCrunch 报道，Databricks 有 1.2 万名员工，CEO Ali Ghodsi 使用新版 Genie agent 来了解公司真实情况，而不是依赖员工逐级汇报问题。
stories.analysis: 企业 AI agent 正从写代码、查数据扩展到管理层决策支持，关键在于它能否可靠整合内部信号并避免幻觉。
stories.sourceExcerpt: With Databricks at 12,000 employees, AI Ghodsi is the first to admit that he can't know everyone and that they are unlikely to confess the things that go wrong to him. But he doesn't need them to. He uses Databricks' newly revised Genie agent for that.

stories.title: Plurai 想用自动驾驶思路提升 AI agent 可靠性
stories.sourceTitle: Plurai wants to help AI agents work better using the same approach that helped get self-driving cars to roads
stories.summary: TechCrunch 报道，Plurai 借鉴训练自动驾驶端到端模型的方法，试图让在不可预测环境中运行的 AI agent 表现更好。
stories.analysis: 把 agent 视为概率系统而非确定性程序，是提升企业级可靠性的务实方向，但落地效果仍需场景验证。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Like the end-to-end models trained to drive cars, AI agents are probabilistic systems operating in unpredictable environments.

stories.title: The Verge：美国正赢得 AI 竞赛，黄仁勋风波可能毁掉优势
stories.sourceTitle: The US is winning the AI race. Jensen Huang could have blown it
stories.summary: The Verge 评论称，黄仁勋作为全球最有价值公司之一、掌握 AI 热潮关键技术的 CEO，本就是间谍活动的高价值目标，其风波可能让美国 AI 优势受挫。
stories.analysis: 这篇文章把个人丑闻放进地缘技术竞争框架，提醒市场 NVIDIA 的风险不只是股价，还包括政策与安全信任。
stories.sourceExcerpt: As espionage targets go, Jensen Huang is perhaps one of the least surprising on Earth. The Nvidia CEO runs one of the world's most valuable companies, controls the in-demand technology fueling the AI boom, and is cozy with presidents, CEOs, and all manner of i

stories.title: Anthropic 推出自己的 AI 办公套件
stories.sourceTitle: Anthropic has its own AI-powered office suite now
stories.summary: The Verge 报道，长期专注企业和编程工具的 Anthropic 现在有了 AI 办公套件；其 Claude Code 等产品曾影响 OpenAI、Meta 等前沿实验室的策略。
stories.analysis: Anthropic 从模型和编码工具延伸到办公套件，意味着它与 Microsoft、Google 在 AI 生产力入口的竞争更直接。
stories.sourceExcerpt: For years, Anthropic has been known for its focus on enterprise and coding tools that attract high-flying corporate clients, inspiring competing frontier labs - like OpenAI, SpaceXSI, and Meta - to copy its strategies. Earlier this year, Claude Code went throu

stories.title: OpenAI 向退伍军人和现役军人提供一年免费 ChatGPT Plus
stories.sourceTitle: ChatGPT Plus for veterans and servicemembers
stories.summary: OpenAI 称已有超过 2 万名退伍军人和过渡期服役人员领取一年免费 ChatGPT Plus，并用它准备平民职业发展。
stories.analysis: 这是 OpenAI 扩大公共部门用户和品牌好感的举措，也为 AI 在职业转型培训中的实际使用提供样本。
stories.sourceExcerpt: More than 20,000 veterans and transitioning service members have claimed a free year of ChatGPT Plus. See how they use it to prepare for civilian careers.

stories.title: 谷歌发布首款决策模型 Gemini Decision 1：9 项测试 7 项第一，最高准确率 92.2%
stories.sourceTitle: 谷歌发布首款决策模型 Gemini Decision 1：9 项测试拿下 7 项第一，准确率最高92.2%
stories.summary: InfoQ 中文报道，谷歌发布首款决策模型 Gemini Decision 1，称其在 9 项测试中拿下 7 项第一，最高准确率达 92.2%。
stories.analysis: 决策模型强调在业务判断场景中可量化胜出，但需关注测试基准是否贴近真实生产环境。

stories.sourceTitle: “双十一”机器人在物流仓“埋头苦干”：昆腾动力开启具身智能规模化获客与交付阶段
stories.summary: 量子位报道，昆腾动力在跨境称重量方等物流场景完成 PMF 验证并出现客户复购，新一代构型机器人计划 12 月底发布。

stories.title: Qwen 发布 Qwen3Guard：为 Token 流提供实时安全防护

stories.summary: Qwen 团队推出 Qwen 系列首个安全护栏模型 Qwen3Guard，基于 Qwen3 基座微调，用于对 token 流进行实时安全分类和防护。
